set.body:
Outcome: commit qualified resident-session tranche, qualify whole-brain synthetic cohort latency, improve ingress and support bounded cohorts plus explicit retained state for contrast edits.
Scope / non-goals: existing fmridataset/fmrimod/fmrireg providers; no new regression algebra, real subject data, silent IID fallback or remote publication. Durable decompressed cache only if evidence warrants it.
Invariants: exact spatial/observation identity and model/noise invalidation; caller requested outputs independent of retained internal coefficients/scales; budgets checked before numerical allocation; preserve unrelated work.
Relevant paths: fmridataset/src/nifti.rs; fmrimod/src/{session,cohort}.rs; fmrimod/examples/cohort_latency.rs; scripts/generate_cohort.py; fmrireg/src/output.rs.
Proposed change: scoped commit; parameterized synthetic fixture and fixed/estimated AR benchmark with peak RSS; bounded parallel input admission and lazy per-subject execution for nonresident cohorts; optional explicit coefficient/scale retention for contrast edits. Decide persistent decoded cache from timings.
Acceptance: independent/reference parity, serial/parallel and retained/scan equality including uncertainty, invalidation and exact/under-budget witnesses; scoped cargo test/clippy/fmt; reproducible source/fixture hashes, wall time and RSS receipts.
Risks / escalation: disk below 20GB blocks full builds; verified idle workspace target cleanup pending user approval. Do not remove other artifacts. Existing workspace/provider baseline remains untracked and belongs to consolidation work.
Next action: save scoped commit while cache approval pending, then qualify benchmark before selecting cache implementation.
set.title: Whole-brain cohort qualification and bounded interactive execution
